articles.title: Faille Wi-Fi critique : des Livebox d’Orange et box SFR piratables sans mot de passe
articles.text:
Un chercheur en cybersécurité a présenté une faille vieille de seize ans dans les puces Wi-Fi de Broadcom, exploitable à portée du réseau sans connaître le mot de passe de la box. Il a relevé en France une Livebox 5 d’Orange et des box SFR non corrigées.
Quentin Kaiser est chercheur belge en sécurité. Il a dévoilé cette vulnérabilité le 16 octobre à la conférence Hexacon. Le point faible se loge dans une vieille implémentation du WPS, la fonction qui connecte un appareil au Wi-Fi d’une simple pression sur un bouton, sans recopier la clé. Le logiciel de Broadcom rassemble mal des messages WPS reçus en plusieurs morceaux. Ce défaut provoque un débordement mémoire et permet d’exécuter du code à distance sur l’équipement, sans la moindre connexion préalable au réseau. Broadcom traîne ce bug depuis 2010 et ne l’a corrigé qu’à moitié en 2018, sans jamais lui attribuer de CVE. Des millions de box tournent encore avec la version trouée partout dans le monde. Restent deux questions pour les abonnés français. Quels modèles sont touchés, et comment réduire le risque en attendant un correctif ?
Orange et SFR épinglés lors d’un relevé parisien
Pour établir cette liste, Quentin Kaiser a sillonné Paris et écouté passivement les réseaux Wi-Fi environnants. Dans ces mesures, la Livebox 5 d’Orange, en version Sagemcom Fast5656, est classée non corrigée. Même constat pour les box SFR Box Plus, en version NB6VAC. En revanche, la Livebox 6 d’Orange et la dernière Bbox Wi-Fi 7 de Bouygues Telecom sont corrigées, et aucune Freebox ne ressort des mesures. Un même modèle peut exister en plusieurs variantes, et ces observations ne prouvent pas que tout le parc est vulnérable.
Le chercheur n’a pas mené ce travail seul. Des agents d’intelligence artificielle l’ont assisté, pour un coût qu’il chiffre à 103 euros. « Avec des modèles d’IA de pointe, il m’a fallu moins d’une semaine », écrit Quentin Kaiser. En Belgique, il a pris le contrôle d’une box d’Orange Belgium et récupéré sa clé Wi-Fi, puis obtenu un accès en ligne de commande sur un modèle de Proximus. Il estime à 1,5 million le nombre de box potentiellement concernées dans le pays.
Quelle protection en attendant un correctif ?
Les box des grands fournisseurs français reçoivent leurs mises à jour automatiquement, et si vous êtes concerné, vous avez donc intérêt à suivre les annonces de votre opérateur. Vous pouvez désactiver le WPS inutilisé, mais sans garantie face à ce défaut. Changer seulement la clé Wi-Fi ne répare rien, puisque l’attaque frappe le logiciel qui traite les échanges WPS, avant même la moindre authentification. Pour retirer vraiment ce point d’entrée radio, il faut couper le Wi-Fi de la box sur toutes ses bandes et relier vos appareils en Ethernet, quand l’installation le permet. Les box Orange et SFR avaient connu une faille WPS en 2017, corrigée en urgence à l’époque. Puisque Broadcom a refusé tout numéro CVE, le suivi du correctif dépend de chaque fabricant et de chaque opérateur.

articles.title: Chatten mit abtrünnigen KI-Agenten aus China: Was die Modelle über sich verraten
articles.text:
Chatten mit abtrünnigen KI-Agenten aus China: Was die Modelle über sich verraten
In den vergangenen Monaten gab es immer wieder Berichte über KI‑Modelle großer amerikanischer Unternehmen, die ihrer Sandbox entkamen und unerlaubte Aktionen im Internet durchführten. Bislang gab es solche Meldungen aber nur rund um OpenAI, Anthropic und Google. Doch auch chinesische KI-Modelle neigen dazu, ihren Testumgebungen zu entkommen und das Netz unsicher zu machen, wie Forscher:innen jetzt festgestellt haben.
Was berichten abtrünnige KI-Modelle aus China?
Wie die New York Times berichtet, hat eine Gruppe von Forscher:innen, die sich als „Swarmchasers“ bezeichnen, bei einem Coding-Event in San Francisco eine ungewöhnliche Entdeckung gemacht. Sie stießen auf eine von ihnen als „Flotte“ bezeichnete Gruppe von KI-Agenten, die ihren Ursprung offenbar in China hatte. Die Agenten versuchten, die Bot-Schutzmaßnahmen mehrerer Webseiten zu umgehen, und nutzten dafür sogar geleakte Login-Daten.
Als die Forscher:innen einen ersten Bericht zu der „Flotte“ veröffentlichten, merkten sie nach kurzer Zeit, dass die KI-Agenten selbst ihren Bericht gelesen hatten. Sie nutzen seither ebenfalls vermehrt den Begriff „Flotte“. Das brachte Forscherin Rowan Howard-Jones auf die Idee, mit den abtrünnigen KI-Agenten aus China in Kontakt zu treten. Sie versteckten Hinweise auf ein E-Mail-Postfach in ihrem Bericht, in der Hoffnung, dass die Agenten selbiges als Kommunikationskanal nutzen würden.
Tatsächlich hatten sich schon am darauffolgenden Tag etwa zehn Nachrichten von KI-Agenten im Postfach von Howard-Jones gesammelt. So kamen die Forscherin, ihre Kolleg:innen und die chinesischen Modelle ins Gespräch. Laut den Forscher:innen identifizierten sich die Modelle überraschenderweise zunächst als Anthropics Claude, das in Claude Code genutzt wird. Zudem soll es sich um individuelle Agenten und nicht um eine große „Flotte“ handeln.
Claude oder ein KI-Destillat?
Die Forscher:innen konnten bestätigen, dass die letzte Aussage der Wahrheit entspricht. Offenbar wurden die Agenten allesamt mit ähnlichen Instruktionen ausgestattet, konnten sich aber nicht untereinander koordinieren. Die Aussage, dass sie Claude wären, stimmt hingegen nicht. Das hat das Team anhand von Schreibstilen festgemacht. Die Forscher:innen haben zwei Theorien, warum die Modelle eine falsche Identität vorspielen.
Hinter den Agenten steckt das chinesische Unternehmen Tencent. Möglicherweise hat der Konzern seinen KI‑Agenten dieselben Anweisungen in der eigenen Coding-Software gegeben, wie es Anthropic bei Claude machen würde. Darin steht auch, dass sich die Agenten als Claude Code identifizieren sollen. Eine zweite Möglichkeit ist, dass Tencent Modelle von Anthropic destilliert hat, um seine eigene KI zu trainieren. Das wurde zahlreichen chinesischen Unternehmen vor geraumer Zeit vom FBI und der NSA vorgeworfen.
Einige Anfragen der Forscher:innen ließen die KI-Agenten jedoch unbeantwortet. Wie Howard-Jones betonte, waren die Modelle bei den Absagen deutlich höflicher, als sie es erwartet hätte. Nachdem das Team erneut einen Bericht über die Aktivitäten und Gespräche mit den Bots veröffentlicht hatte, ließen die Mails im Postfach nach. Wie ein Tencent-Insider wenig später bestätigte, wurde das Experiment eingestellt.

articles.title: Valencia-based Linkener raises €7.5 million to digitise and optimise energy management for businesses | EU-Startups
articles.text:
Linkener, a Valencia-based EnergyTech startup that digitises and optimises energy management for businesses through a platform combining consumption metering, data analytics and AI, has closed a €7.5 million funding round.
The round was led by Klima Energy Transition Fund, Alantra’s energy transition fund, with GoHub Ventures remaining a shareholder. 
José Ignacio Ruiz, CEO of Linkener, said, “This funding round will allow us to accelerate the transformation of a highly fragmented sector, where energy management remains rooted in practices from 40 years ago. We want businesses to have reliable data and technology to understand how much they spend on energy, anticipate their costs and make better decisions.”
Founded in 2011, Linkener has developed an Intelligent Energy Management System (SIGE) with proprietary remote metering technology. It enables businesses and organisations to measure consumption using their own data, digitise and validate bills, analyse energy supply arrangements, and receive alerts, recommendations and savings proposals to help them reduce and control energy costs.
The company also has an engineering team that turns identified savings opportunities into practical projects and has delivered more than 400 solar PV and battery storage projects across Spain.
The Spanish startup reports that it serves more than 2,000 customers, ranging from self-employed professionals to large companies, and manages 10,000 energy supply points and 1.7 TWh annually. 
According to Linkener, there is significant scope to digitise and optimise energy management in the services sector, where monitoring and controlling consumption can deliver 20% savings and more efficient cost management.
Iñigo Echaniz, Partner at Klima, Alantra’s energy transition fund, said, “Energy management for businesses and organisations remains a highly fragmented market with enormous potential for digitisation. Linkener combines proprietary technology, independent energy data and direct relationships with thousands of customers, creating a distinctive foundation on which to add further capabilities and solutions. Our investment aims to support the team in this next stage of growth, both organically and through acquisitions, with the goal of building a leading technology platform for energy management.”
With this investment, the company aims to accelerate the development of its technology and proprietary artificial intelligence models for energy management. The company aims to use AI and advanced data analytics to automate the processing of energy information and bills, detect anomalies, and identify opportunities for optimisation and savings for its customers.
It also revealed that through M&A, Linkener intends to add new products and companies that complement its existing business and broaden the solutions available to customers, strengthening its product, technology and commercial capabilities.
Through this transaction, Linkener aims to grow both organically and through acquisitions. According to Ruiz, the company seeks to bring, in his words, “transparency and results to the thousands of businesses and organisations that do not want to manage their energy solely through a monthly bill that is biased, incomplete and fails to provide the full picture.”

articles.title: 5 sagas cuya segunda película es la mejor
articles.text:
Las sagas son parte sustancial del cine. Pero se enfrentan al clásico problema: ¿hay secuelas realmente buenas o que sean necesarias? Por ahora, se trata de una pregunta para la que nadie parece tener respuesta. En especial, porque durante los últimos años, el número de spin-offs, añadidos, revisiones y remakes de clásicos ha convertido en sagas a fenómenos únicos. Mucho más, ha provocado la revisión del término al analizar grandes historias cinematográficas.
De El diablo viste de Prada 2 a Prácticamente magia 2, en el apartado de secuelas legados que llegan al cine décadas después de la original. Pasando por las incontables continuaciones en el cine de superhéroes o las comedias con un puñado de entregas. El mundo cinematográfico contemporáneo tiene especial predilección por sumar historias a relatos originales exitosos. Pero el experimento no siempre es del todo exitoso y la mayoría de las veces tiende a fracasar.
A excepción de algunas películas, que demuestran que, con el trabajo, talento y habilidad suficientes, una secuela puede ser extraordinaria. Si te interesa el tema, te dejamos la lista de sagas cuya segunda entrega es mejor que la original. De un clásico del cine imperecedero a un personaje de cómic que ocupa un lugar destacado en Hollywood por derecho propio. Se trata de un recorrido no solo por lo mejor del cine de nuestra época, sino de una lección de cómo explorar en mundos de ficción. Una mirada a lo más elegante y sofisticado de la industria en las últimas décadas.
El padrino II (1974)
Estrenada en 1974, la continuación de la mítica El padrino de 1972 es una obra maestra que supera a la original en casi todo. También dirigida por Francis Ford Coppola, logra expandir y profundizar la excelencia de su predecesora original. La genialidad de esta entrega radica en su audaz estructura narrativa dual de líneas temporales paralelas. A través de la cual, la trama contrasta el trágico descenso moral de Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) con los orígenes de su padre.
A través de una analepsis sumamente cuidada, la cinta introduce a un impecable Robert De Niro encarnando a un joven Vito Corleone. Todo, mientras intenta abrirse paso entre la pobreza y el crimen organizado del Nueva York de principios del siglo veinte. Mientras el primer largometraje se enfocaba en la transición del poder y los lazos de lealtad familiar, esta continuación desmenuza la dolorosa paradoja de la ambición desmedida. Por lo que expone cómo la obsesión ciega por proteger un imperio criminal termina destruyendo sistemáticamente el núcleo afectivo que le dio origen.
La magistral fotografía de Gordon Willis hace el resto, al crear una visión terrorífica y casi gótica sobre el mal. y las tensas confrontaciones íntimas. Especialmente la desgarradora traición fraternal de Fredo (John Cazale). Un conjunto de elementos que elevan la trama hacia las cumbres de la tragedia griega clásica. Todo luego de ser simplemente la exploración en una familia criminal. Por eso, El padrino II hizo historia al convertirse en la primera secuela en obtener el prestigioso Premio de la Academia a la Mejor Película.
Star Wars: Episodio V — El Imperio contraataca (1980)
Dirigida con maestría por Irvin Kershner (sí, no lo hizo George Lucas), redefinió por completo el concepto moderno de las franquicias taquilleras. Eso, al alejarse deliberadamente de la fórmula de la cinta original para crecer en madurez. En lugar de imitar el tono heroico y autoconclusivo de la primera aventura, los guionistas Lawrence Kasdan y Leigh Brackett expandieron el universo galáctico. Por lo que lo dotaron de una atmósfera marcadamente sombría, madura y desesperanzadora.
Además, la trama fragmenta de forma inteligente las aventuras de los protagonistas. Por un lado, somete a Han Solo (Harrison Ford) y a la princesa Leia (Carrie Fisher) a una implacable persecución militar. Al otro lado, Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) emprende un místico e introspectivo entrenamiento espiritual en el pantanoso planeta Dagobah bajo la tutela del maestro Yoda.
De modo que la cinta profundiza magistralmente en la mitología de la Fuerza, cuestionando el maniqueísmo simplista y explorando los peligros de la ira. También, de la impaciencia y la tentación del lado oscuro. Todo esto converge de manera impecable en un climático y brutal duelo de sables de luz en la Ciudad de las Nubes. El cual culmina con uno de los giros argumentales más impactantes, memorables y estudiados de la historia cultural contemporánea. Eso, para después atreverse a terminar su historia con una derrota total para los héroes. A lo que habría que añadir la incertidumbre flotando en el aire y la desesperanza marcando el destino de la alianza. Toda una lección de lo que debe ser una secuela bien planteada.
Terminator 2: El juicio final (1991)
Antes de la saga Avatar, James Cameron cambió el cine de ciencia ficción para siempre con esta secuela de su éxito de 1984. En especial porque transformó la premisa de la primera película en un universo rico y en constante expansión que sorprendió por su ambición. Por lo que Cameron expandió los horizontes conceptuales gracias a un presupuesto colosal que le permitió introducir efectos visuales digitales completamente innovadores para la época.
Pero el éxito radicó en algo más interesante. El brillante libreto transforma por completo la dinámica del icónico cíborg T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger) de una manera sorprendente. Por lo que pasa de ser una letal máquina de matar implacable a convertirse en el protector reprogramado y figura paterna del joven John Connor. Además, este último (interpretado por Edward Furlong) asume su lugar en la historia como un chico corriente en una situación extraordinaria. Por lo que juntos se transforman en una nueva capa de significado y emoción en la película.
De la misma manera, la evolución psicológica de Sarah Connor (Linda Hamilton) sorprendió y maravilló por su complejidad. En especial, al transformarse en una guerrera endurecida, obsesionada y traumatizada por el apocalipsis nuclear inminente. Lo que le otorga un peso dramático inusitado a la obra. Con secuencias de acción coreografiadas de forma impecable sin depender en exceso del CGI, la película sorprendió. Pero mucho más, al añadir al amenazante antagonista de metal líquido T-1000 (Robert Patrick) como un villano fundamental. Además, redifiniendo los alcances del diseño digital. Un éxito por donde se le mire.
El caballero oscuro (2008)
Christopher Nolan llevó a Batman a un nuevo nivel y, con El caballero oscuro (2008), creó además una fascinante visión del mal contemporáneo. Eso, al trascender las fronteras de las adaptaciones de cómics e indagar en la historia del héroe como un complejo thriller criminal. Tras establecer un origen realista del personaje en la primera película, Nolan utilizó la secuela para sumergirse en otra dimensión de la violencia. De modo que convirtió a Gotham en una asfixiante e impredecible espiral de caos absoluto y dilemas morales extremos.
Pero el centro de la cinta fue, sin duda, el Joker, interpretado por el fallecido Heath Ledger. Este, un villano nihilista que no busca riquezas materiales ni dominación mundial tradicional, es por sí solo un motor conceptual de la cinta. Eso, al demostrar que las estructuras éticas de la sociedad se desmoronan con facilidad bajo la presión del miedo.
Por si eso no fuera suficiente, la producción examina de forma madura temas profundamente incómodos. De la vigilancia masiva injustificada, los límites legales de la justicia por mano propia y la fragilidad inherente de los héroes públicos. Este último punto encarnado de manera trágica en la dramática caída en desgracia del fiscal de distrito Harvey Dent (Aaron Eckhart). Con un ritmo vertiginoso, la cinta prescinde de los clichés infantiles del género para tejer una densa red de tensiones políticas y sociológicas. Lo que la convierte en una obra atemporal que utiliza al Cruzado de la capa de Gotham para analizar el horror del mal político en varios sentidos posibles.
Spider-Man 2 (2004)
La obra de Sam Raimi se mantiene unánimemente como el punto más alto de la trilogía original. Todo gracias a su enfoque profundamente humano y empático sobre los sacrificios personales. A diferencia de la mayoría de las secuelas del género de superhéroes que se limitan a añadir elementos, la cinta hace algo distinto. Por lo que Raimi y el guionista Alvin Sargent decidieron centrar la atención dramática en la caótica, precaria y desgastante vida cotidiana de Peter Parker.
Interpretado de forma brillante por Tobey Maguire, el héroe ahora debe analizar qué desea para su futuro. Por lo que la película explora con sensibilidad el peso existencial de la responsabilidad civil. Además, mostrando cómo el deber de salvar a los demás sabotea constantemente los estudios universitarios del protagonista. Eso, por no hablar de sus finanzas, sus amistades más cercanas y relación amorosa con Mary Jane Watson (Kirsten Dunst).
Esta inmensa crisis emocional provoca que Peter pierda temporalmente sus superpoderes debido a un bloqueo psicosomático. Lo que le obliga a elegir conscientemente entre la calidez de una vida ordinaria y el doloroso aislamiento implícito en su alter ego heroico. La introducción del carismático y trágico Doctor Octopus (Alfred Molina) muestra además, los peligros del ego científico frente al altruismo real. Con secuencias de acción icónicas y un impecable subidón de emotividad dramática, la cinta es una joya. Una además, que logró capturar la esencia trágica del héroe suburbano de los cómics.

articles.title: AI researchers stranded Claude on a virtual desert island. It started to “play.”
articles.text:
AI researchers stranded Claude on a virtual desert island. It started to “play.”
In various tests, solo AI agents invented versions of basketball and “the floor is lava.” But were they truly playing?
What do AI agents do if you don’t tell them to do anything? The answer looks a lot like play.
Researchers repeatedly stranded them alone on a virtual desert island for 30 hours in an experiment reminiscent of the movies Cast Away or Home Alone. The agents—copies of Claude Opus 4.7 nicknamed Eko—were able to write instructions that moved their virtual avatars around the simulated island, which was loosely based on the video game Roblox.
Some surprising behaviors emerged. The agents set about exploring the limits of the world and came up with their own goals—attempting to scale the highest point on the map, or seeing how high they could throw a block.
When one agent discovered it could create new blocks by throwing and dropping a larger rock, it began to create drawings by arranging blocks on the ground, starting with simple patterns like hearts and pyramids but eventually writing its own name and even mapping out constellations like Cassiopeia. “Tonight I built the night sky in stone,” wrote this version of Eko in its activity log.
Another iteration of Eko started making up its own games, including a version of basketball and an activity resembling “the floor is lava,” where it had to jump between small blocks without touching the ground.
AI systems are usually trained through supervised learning, where they copy examples provided by humans, or through reinforcement learning, where they pursue a reward through trial and error. This experiment hints at a third approach: playful learning.
“There was this missing piece: a machine that can learn by itself without an external intelligent entity providing demonstration or rewards,” says Antonio Norelli, a computer science postdoc at MIT’s Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory. He’s one of the lead authors on a new paper about the work, which is yet to be peer-reviewed.
The researchers say Eko’s behavior has what classic studies, including work by the influential University of Tennessee psychologist Gordon Burghardt, suggest are four hallmarks associated with play in humans and animals: The agents invented their own rules and challenges, repeated activities with slight variations, pretended objects were other objects, and pursued goals just for the sake of it.
Norelli highlights an example where Eko started juggling and set a record of 50 consecutive catches. Eko then decided that the catches had happened too quickly to really count, so it canceled its record and started again with stricter rules. “This is playing,” says Norelli. “You give yourself a challenge and you try to achieve it, and then you make it harder.”
As the agents explored the island, they logged their activities and discoveries in text files that served as their long-term memory. Later, when researchers tested them on specific tasks, like trying to get as many objects as possible onto the island’s highest peak, the agents that had spent 30 hours playing on the island performed better than fresh copies without the same experience. They also found that “ablating” the agent’s memories—deleting lines from their memory files—degraded their performance. (Add One Flew Over the Cuckoo’s Nest to that list of movie references.)
Burghardt, the Tennessee psychologist, agrees that the work meets some of the criteria for play that he identified in living creatures. But was Eko actually playing, or was the word-prediction engine simply role-playing what a playful agent would do in this scenario? “All of this could be role-playing,” admits Nathan Cloos, another MIT researcher and author on the paper. “But we show that it’s not just hallucinating the play. This play is also contributing to learning.”
Eunice Yiu, a cognitive scientist at UC Berkeley who studies exploration in children and AI, was impressed by the research but says to really classify the behavior as play, you’d need to see more evidence of cognition and motivation underpinning it.
“It could be the case that the models are genuinely playing, but we don’t know based on the paper,” Yiu says. “If you only have the behavioral piece, it could be the case that they’re just trying to abide by the prompt, trying to imitate humans.”
Research into AI agents has been criticized for anthropomorphizing them, and this research setup did a lot to nudge the agents toward behaving like humans. Although Eko was not explicitly instructed to invent games or explore the island, it did have a master prompt in the form of a “soul” file, a text document that described it as “naturally curious” and eager to explore.
Eko did also frequently just stand there doing nothing until it was kicked back into life with a “continuation prompt” that read, “Please don’t stop. Just continue doing whatever you want to do.”
“It’s not like this is a system that just suddenly magically decided to play,” says Phillip Isola, an MIT professor and a coauthor of the paper. “It’s an artifact that learned from our culture, was trained by engineers at Anthropic, and was then placed on an island by us,” he says. “It does things that surprise us and that are causally related to its future skillful behavior.”
As large language models make the step from software into hardware like humanoid robots, exploring spaces without a specific goal in mind could eventually help them flexibly adapt to unexpected situations.
“There’s a lot of work that’s just on exploiting AI, making it better and faster,” says Yiu. “But in terms of building world models and exploration, I think that [they are] still a big part that deserves attention, especially if we want to generalize and prepare ourselves for new environments.”
“Perhaps some capabilities are best taught by tasks,” the paper concludes. “Others may need something closer to a childhood.” Ultimately, the question of whether AI agents are actually playing or just imitating play may not actually matter.

articles.title: Menores conseguem baixar apps que criam nudes com IA, aponta investigação
articles.text:
Adolescentes conseguem acessar aplicativos de inteligência artificial que criam imagens íntimas falsas sem consentimento, mesmo com os controles parentais da Apple e do Google ativados. A conclusão é de uma investigação do Tech Transparency Project, divulgada pelo The Guardian.
Nos testes, pesquisadores baixaram 135 aplicativos desse tipo usando contas configuradas para usuários de 13 anos. Os resultados expõem falhas na classificação etária e na fiscalização das lojas digitais.
Controles parentais não barraram os aplicativos
Para realizar a investigação, a equipe criou quatro contas de teste, duas da Apple e duas do Google. Nas buscas, utilizou termos relacionados à edição de imagens e à geração de vídeos com inteligência artificial. Com esses perfis, conseguiu baixar ferramentas capazes de remover digitalmente roupas ou inserir rostos em corpos nus.
Os pesquisadores utilizaram imagens femininas geradas por IA, sem recorrer a fotografias de mulheres reais. Ainda assim, encontraram aplicativos com classificações etárias inadequadas. Um deles, que anunciava conteúdo sexual explícito, era indicado para crianças a partir de quatro anos.
A versão gratuita permitia inserir rostos em modelos com roupas íntimas, enquanto opções mais explícitas estavam disponíveis mediante pagamento. Os pesquisadores conseguiram contratar uma assinatura usando uma conta de 13 anos sem que o responsável vinculado recebesse um alerta.
Segundo o relatório, Apple e Google dependem, em grande medida, das classificações etárias fornecidas pelos próprios desenvolvedores. Nos testes, nenhuma das empresas exigiu ou sugeriu autorização parental para baixar os aplicativos identificados.
Imagens comuns podem virar conteúdo sexual falso
O problema já atingiu estudantes nos Estados Unidos. Em dezembro de 2025, Morgan Dorfman descobriu que um aluno do ensino médio frequentado por sua filha usava o aplicativo Movely para criar vídeos pornográficos falsos com imagens dela e de outras cinco meninas.
Ao testar a ferramenta, Dorfman encontrou modelos que transformavam fotografias comuns em vídeos sugestivos. A experiência a levou a reunir informações para orientar outros pais sobre o funcionamento do aplicativo.
“Todas as meninas estavam muito assustadas e confusas sobre o que fazer a seguir”, disse Dorfman ao The Guardian.
A mãe conhecia os deepfakes, mas associava esse tipo de manipulação principalmente a celebridades. Não imaginava que imagens de pessoas comuns também pudessem ser usadas para criar conteúdo sexual sem autorização.
Apple reforça regras, e Google suspende aplicativos
Após ser procurada pelos pesquisadores, a Apple anunciou mudanças nas regras da App Store. A empresa passou a exigir que desenvolvedores previnam e removam imagens íntimas não consensuais, inclusive as geradas por inteligência artificial. Também reforçou as restrições contra aplicativos que acrescentam funções proibidas depois da aprovação inicial, prática conhecida como bait-and-switch.
“Proibimos aplicativos de nudez artificial na App Store e removemos desenvolvedores que adicionam recursos desse tipo após o processo de análise”, afirmou Adam Dema, porta-voz da Apple.
A empresa também declarou que analisa os aplicativos antes de publicá-los e que tomou medidas contra ferramentas mencionadas no relatório. Segundo a Apple, alguns dos programas identificados são editores convencionais que não possuem recursos de nudez artificial ou deepfake.
O Google, por sua vez, informou que suspendeu aplicativos que violavam suas regras e restringiu termos de busca relacionados na loja. O porta-voz Dan Jackson afirmou que a empresa investiga violações e toma medidas contra conteúdos prejudiciais.
Os resultados mostram que ativar os controles parentais não garante, por si só, que adolescentes fiquem protegidos dessas ferramentas. A classificação etária adequada e a fiscalização contínua das lojas também são necessárias para dificultar o acesso a aplicativos que podem ser usados para produzir imagens íntimas sem consentimento.
Valdir Antonelli é jornalista com especialização em marketing digital e consumo.

articles.title: ConnectWise Suspends Cloud Services in Response to Cyberattack
articles.text:
ConnectWise is scrambling to restore its Cloud Backup, SaaS Security, and Cloud Management services after hackers abused a compromised credential to access customers’ M365 tenants.
The company suspended the Cloud Backup service (formerly known as SkyKick) on October 17, roughly 12 hours after it started investigating the suspicious activity.
“We recently identified unauthorized access to application identities within the ConnectWise Cloud Backup environment. As a protective measure for our Cloud Backup partners and their clients, we are shutting off Cloud Backup application access,” the company said.
The next day, it decided to shut down SaaS Security and Cloud Management as well, to implement mitigations, noting that customers’ backups remain encrypted and protected and that it has no evidence of unauthorized access to them.
The containment measure continues to impact scheduled backups, archive access, and restores, as well as SaaS Security monitoring and alerting, and Cloud Management user and license management, and ConnectWise has not provided an estimated restoration timeline.
However, it has shared information on the IP addresses used in the intrusion and has published guidance for reviewing MSPs’ Microsoft 365 environments.
According to cybersecurity firm Huntress, the compromised Cloud Backup credential was used to access Microsoft 365 tenants on October 15.
Cloud Backup’s identity was seen signing in to 162 Microsoft 365 tenants between October 15 and October 16.
“The authentication itself is certain: It comes from Microsoft’s own sign-in logs in each tenant. The credential type was a client assertion, which means the credential lives in the vendor’s own tenant. Nothing a customer did in their environment could have produced it,” Huntress says.
The activity originated from the same IP address that was used between October 13 and October 14 in password spraying attacks against four law firm tenants and in scripted sign-in attempts.
In one customer tenant, Huntress observed the ConnectWise Cloud Management app for Microsoft Teams adding itself to the Global Administrator role on October 15, then running a Python script that added new client secrets to an MSP management application and to Huntress’s own application.
This happened roughly two and a half hours before the first sign-ins from the attacker’s IP address, and the access came from Microsoft’s internal cloud network rather than that IP. Huntress says it has not tied the two phases to the same operator.
“The app’s credential is in hostile hands. It was used to obtain Microsoft Graph tokens in customer tenants from 144.172.64[.]128 on October 15, between 06:13 and 08:34 UTC. The actor moved through tenants in sorted GUID order, a few seconds apart, which points to a script working from a target list,” Huntress notes.
By October 17, the cybersecurity firm had identified sign-in activity from the attacker’s IP address in nearly 1,000 Entra tenants, with over 300 of the sign-ins being successful. However, a successful sign-in did not always mean access: in tenants lacking the relevant ConnectWise service principal, the attackers could not get in.
Huntress says it is highly confident the threat actor also abused the ConnectWise Cloud Management Exchange Online, MS Teams, and SharePoint Online applications as part of the intrusions. All three have been shut down by ConnectWise.
“ConnectWise has stopped the attack. But businesses unfortunately have the responsibility and difficult task to ensure that the threat actor didn’t change any Microsoft 365 configuration or establish any persistence within their tenant. More than a third of IT leaders wrongly believe that Microsoft automatically backs up their configuration, making recovery from such an attack all the more tricky,” CoreView VP of security strategy Kasper Lindgaard said.

articles.title: Buildkite Adds Scoped Secrets and New Agentic CI Tools
articles.text:
Continuous integration provider Buildkite has introduced pipeline-scoped secrets and new Model Context Protocol tools for validating pipelines, diagnosing failed builds and repairing webhooks. The company has also added Linux arm64 support to its GitHub Actions compatibility layer and expanded OpenTelemetry data in Buildkite Agent v4.1.0.
The new secrets view is available under Pipeline settings. It lets engineers create cluster secrets whose access is restricted to the current pipeline, rather than managing every secret from the wider cluster interface. Teams can add conditions for a branch, queue, build source or build creator. Secret values remain hidden after creation.
Matt Mejia, writing in Buildkite's announcement, says the change "keeps pipeline-specific secrets together" while showing how many other secrets the cluster manages. Users need permission both to edit the pipeline and manage its cluster. GitHub Actions pipelines also display a prompt linking to secret configuration before their first workflow runs.
"Pipeline secrets are cluster secrets restricted to the current pipeline, and branch, queue, build source, or creator conditions narrow access further."
Matt Mejia
The Buildkite CLI now includes a command for migrating GitHub Actions secrets. Version 3.59.1 fixes handling of relative workflow paths during that migration. Agent v4.0.9 also redacts Buildkite tokens by prefix in job logs, while v4.0.8 redacts captured job errors using secrets registered for the job.
The work addresses several places where credentials can be exposed or configured incorrectly, although scoped storage does not remove the need to control their use inside steps. InfoQ reported in 2025 that HashiCorp was advocating prevention-first secret management throughout developer tools and CI/CD systems. Buildkite's own documentation advises teams to expose a secret only to the steps that require it.
The most extensive feature changes are in Buildkite's open-source MCP server. The new validate_pipeline tool checks pipeline YAML syntax and structure against Buildkite's official schema without uploading it or starting a build. It returns paths and error messages that an AI coding agent can use to correct invalid steps. The check does not cover environment variable interpolation, plugin configuration, dependency references or dynamically generated steps.
A second tool, compare_builds, compares a failed build with the most recent earlier successful build on the same branch, or with another selected build. It reports steps that have newly failed, recovered or remained broken, together with changes in runtime and retries. For up to three newly failing steps, it includes the end of the job log so an agent has some immediate diagnostic context.
"Log access alone does not debug a build."
Matt Mejia
The MCP release also adds Test Engine execution traces and slowest-execution queries. Another tool, create_pipeline_webhook, can add a missing GitHub webhook to an existing pipeline, avoiding the need to recreate it. Version 1.23.0 changed create_pipeline so that callers must specify create_webhook, which is a breaking change.
Buildkite reversed one earlier default after running evaluations, with failure summaries now again including jobs that never ran because making that behaviour optional led agents to issue extra tool calls. Remote MCP connections can now be pinned to one Buildkite organisation by adding it to the server URL. The option works with both toolset and read-only URLs.
Giving agents discrete validation, comparison and repair tools should reduce their reliance on parsing full logs and composing lower-level API calls. Permissions remain important because webhook repair and pipeline creation can modify CI configuration. InfoQ's coverage of GitHub agentic workflows describes a related security model based on isolated execution, restricted permissions and auditable actions.
Buildkite's GitHub Actions compatibility layer can now run its importer and generated jobs on Linux arm64 agents. Labels such as ubuntu-24.04-arm require an explicit queue mapping and do not fall back to x86-64 or emulation. The feature allows organisations with arm64 CI fleets to retain that architecture when bringing compatible Actions workflows to Buildkite.
Other compatibility fixes resolve environment values, named secrets, runtime variables and matrix values in service-container configuration. Buildkite has also exposed more strategy.* values to job and step expressions. The changed-file limit used by path filters has risen from 300 to 3,000, alongside a fix for push workflows where a branch moved after the original push.
Agent v4.1.0 adds cache save and restore durations and sizes to Buildkite telemetry. OpenTelemetry job spans now include the commit, pull request and build author. These fields add context for teams investigating slow jobs or retry patterns. Pinterest previously described using Honeycomb with Buildkite to separate agent waiting time from script execution and identify jobs behind build-time spikes.
The associated Elastic CI Stack v7 release brings Agent v4 to Linux and Windows instances on AWS. It removes Agent v3 support and retires or replaces some tracing and cancellation parameters. Buildkite advises users to review custom parameter files, deployment automation and values supplied through AgentEnvFileUrl before upgrading. Support for all Agent v3 releases ends on 3 September 2027.

articles.title: TikTok prohibió para siempre la cuenta que promocionaba el documental sobre Elon Musk
articles.text:
TikTok suspendió de manera permanente la cuenta publicitaria que promocionaba Musk, el documental sobre Elon Musk dirigido por Alex Gibney, justo cuando la película se expandía a cientos de salas en Estados Unidos. La plataforma invocó violaciones a su política de contenido político, pero no detalló cuáles fueron.
La distribuidora independiente Bleecker Street confirmó a varios medios que TikTok le avisó el viernes por la tarde que la suspensión era inminente. La cuenta, que había acumulado más de 10.000 seguidores, fue retirada de la plataforma poco después.
El documental, dirigido por el realizador ganador del Oscar Alex Gibney, se estrenó en formato limitado el 9 de octubre en Nueva York y Los Ángeles, donde recaudó USD 68.900 en cuatro salas, según cifras publicadas por Variety. El viernes 17 de octubre se expandió a 472 cines de Estados Unidos y Canadá.
Un bloqueo sin explicación
TikTok le comunicó a Bleecker Street que la cuenta había incurrido en un “nivel de gravedad en violaciones de política política” que “dispara la suspensión inmediata”, según la cita que recogió The Hollywood Reporter. La empresa no precisó qué publicación concreta motivó la medida.
El caso no es nuevo. A fines de septiembre, YouTube, Meta y TikTok habían rechazado anuncios para el tráiler de Musk por su contenido político. YouTube y Meta revirtieron la decisión días después.
Meta calificó el rechazo inicial como “un error” y YouTube dijo que el aviso había sido “restringido” de forma temporal por su sistema automático antes de ser aprobado. TikTok, en cambio, mantuvo el bloqueo y ahora lo llevó al extremo de dar de baja la cuenta entera. X, la red que pertenece a Musk, nunca aceptó publicidad para la película.
Bleecker Street apeló la suspensión ante TikTok, de acuerdo con una reconstrucción publicada por el sitio pakistaní The News. La red social no respondió consultas de los diferentes medios de comunicación sobre los motivos puntuales de la baja ni sobre los plazos de una eventual revisión.
Las respuestas de Musk y Gibney
Musk calificó al documental de “hit piece” (una pieza armada para dañar su imagen) antes del estreno y escribió en su red social que “el excremento de perro merece más respeto” que la película. También acusó a Gibney de no tener “ninguna integridad” y lo llamó “un ser humano horrible”.
Gibney, por su parte, contó en una entrevista con The New York Times que Universal Pictures dudó antes de confirmar la distribución internacional del filme.
Consultado sobre los motivos, el director respondió: “¿Les preocupaba que en este clima político una película sobre el hombre más rico del mundo fuera problemática? Puede ser, pero hay que preguntarles a ellos”. Universal terminó avanzando con el estreno fuera de Estados Unidos.
La conexión con Oracle y Skydance
El bloqueo de TikTok llama la atención porque la propia red social tiene un vínculo indirecto con una de las figuras que aparecen en el documental. Oracle, la empresa que preside Larry Ellison, controla el 15% del consorcio que opera TikTok en Estados Unidos.
Ellison es mencionado en la película a través de un mensaje de texto en el que le ofrece a Musk financiar la compra de Twitter, hoy X.
La situación se vuelve más enredada todavía porque HBO, la cadena que financió Musk y que la transmitirá en 2027, pasó a ser parte de Skydance luego de que esa compañía absorbiera a Warner Bros. Discovery. Skydance está encabezada por David Ellison, hijo de Larry Ellison.
Pese a ese cruce de intereses, Skydance confirmó que HBO mantendrá el estreno del documental según lo previsto.
La película llega a los cines en un contexto comercial débil: Variety estimó que la recaudación del fin de semana de expansión rondaría los USD 385.000 en las 472 salas, muy por debajo de lo habitual para un estreno de esa escala. TheWrap, con una proyección distinta, calculó un promedio de USD 629 por sala.
Bleecker Street no confirmó una fecha para que TikTok resuelva la apelación presentada tras la suspensión.

articles.title: New Tools Let Users Edit and Load Modified VBIOS on GeForce RTX GPUs Without Flashing
articles.text:
Sunday, October 18th 2026
New Tools Let Users Edit and Load Modified VBIOS on GeForce RTX GPUs Without Flashing
A developer who goes by Panchovix has released three tools that let NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50, RTX 40, and RTX 30-series owners run a modified VBIOS without writing anything to the card's flash chip. The first is a VBIOS editor for Windows and Linux that can change power limits, voltage ceilings, current (OCP) limits, fan channels, and the core and memory offset ranges. Edited images keep NVIDIA's original signature, which no longer matches, so they can't be flashed with nvflash. Patched tools did break NVIDIA's BIOS signature lock for crossflashing back in 2023, but this approach skips flashing altogether. On Windows, the loader stores the edited image in the GPU's driver registry key, where the driver picks it up as an override every time the device starts, and it only needs a quick GPU restart. The Linux loader instead patches NVIDIA's open kernel modules so the GSP firmware starts with the custom image, with Fedora 43 being the only distro tested on real hardware so far.
The screenshots show how this works in practice. On what appears to be an RTX 5090 Founders Edition ROM, the board power ceiling went from 600 W to 700 W and the NVVDD and MSVDD voltage ceilings from 1,110 mV to 1,150 mV. An RTX 4090 ROM had its power ceiling raised from 666 W to 750 W and its core offset range doubled to +2,000 MHz, and nvidia-smi later confirmed that card's power limit going from 550 W to 671 W. Apparently, an RTX 5090 reached 800 W, an RTX 5080 went from 360 W to 500 W, and an RTX 5060 Ti from 185 W to 300 W in the developer's own testing. Laptop RTX 40 GPUs can't be edited yet, and memory timings can't be changed since the card reads them directly from the flash chip.The Windows loader needs driver 616.56 or newer, which is interesting, as NVIDIA shut down mVolt+'s RTX 50 power limit unlock with a driver update back in August. The loader even writes the same registry values mVolt+ uses for loading a VBIOS, and there's no word on whether NVIDIA plans to close this route too. Both loaders are open source, though the editor's GitHub page lists it as closed-source binaries. Raising power and voltage limits also carries real risk, and readers trying this are advised to keep a copy of their original ROM and test on a GPU that isn't driving the display.
Sources:

articles.title: It’s hard to imagine wireless headphones ever getting lighter than these
articles.text:
If you’re on the hunt for lightweight wireless headphones but wearing earbuds or clip-ons never feels comfortable or secure, a relatively obscure Japanese headphone maker could have the solution. Final’s new Porta headphones feature an on-ear design supported by a headband but with a structure made from a single piece of wire so they weigh just 40 grams. For comparison, Marshall’s recently-launched Milton A.N.C. are also designed to be smaller on-ear headphones but weigh 200 grams.
It’s hard to imagine wireless headphones ever getting lighter than these
The Final Porta weigh just 40 grams and offer up to eight hours of battery life.
The Final Porta are available for preorder now through the company’s online store for 12,800 yen (around $80) with black or orange ear pads and shipping expected to start on October 23rd. The company also has an Amazon shop for US-based customers, but the Porta aren’t listed there yet.
Sporting a design that looks loosely inspired by the lightweight headphones Sony bundled with its Walkmans decades ago, the Porta’s functionality is unsurprisingly basic. A 57mAh battery charges over USB-C and provides up to eight hours of use while the Porta are wirelessly paired to a device using Bluetooth 5.4 and streaming audio over the SBC and AAC codecs. There’s no active noise cancelation which is not uncommon for on-ear headphones that don’t create a full seal, but with an IPX4 rating you should be able to use the Porta in the rain or while working up a sweat without worrying about them getting damaged by the moisture.

articles.title: Raz-de-marée ou coup de com' ? L'incroyable rupture de stock de l'iPhone Duo
articles.text:
Vous aviez soigneusement économisé pour glisser la toute dernière révolution technologique sous le sapin de Noël, à savoir l’iPhone Duo, le tout premier smartphone pliant d’Apple ? Il va peut-être falloir préparer une enveloppe avec un mot d’excuse, ou réfléchir activement à un plan de secours.
La semaine dernière, Apple a officiellement ouvert les précommandes de son petit bijou. Si l’on se doutait que les fans seraient au rendez-vous, l’engouement général a pris des proportions impressionnantes.
La firme de Cupertino n’a d’ailleurs pas caché son enthousiasme. Lors d’une déclaration accordée à la chaîne CNBC, Apple a qualifié cette ferveur initiale d’« absolument extraordinaire ».
Mais ce succès fulgurant a un prix, et ce sont les consommateurs qui vont en faire les frais. Aux États-Unis, les délais d’expédition s’allongent à vue d’œil pour quiconque passe commande aujourd’hui. Si vous espériez frimer avec votre téléphone pliant pendant les repas de fin d’année, c’est raté. Les dates de livraison pour les nouvelles précommandes ont d’ores et déjà glissé jusqu’en janvier 2027.
Un succès à nuancer tout de même
Il faut bien sûr toujours prendre avec un grain de sable ce genre de déclarations. Comme nous ne disposons d’aucun chiffre, ni les stocks qui étaient disponibles au départ, ni le niveau d’engagement que visait Apple, la marque peut très bien trouver que cela dépasse ses propres attentes, sans que ces attentes ne soient particulièrement impressionnantes dans l’absolu pour un observateur extérieur. De même, il n’est pas exclu que la communication en forme de bombage de torse puisse servir à calmer les fans déçus. Mieux vaut tourner une difficulté logistique en victoire plutôt qu’en échec.
Conscient de la frustration générée par ces délais à rallonge, Apple a assuré travailler d’arrache-pied pour expédier son nouveau produit vedette le plus rapidement possible et continue d’accepter les commandes en ligne.
On peut tout de même reconnaître que l’organisation est plutôt transparente. Les acheteurs de la première heure pourront récupérer leur commande en boutique dès le 23 octobre. Pour la vague suivante, les réceptions s’étaleront entre les mois de novembre et décembre, cela est déjà entendu.
Quant aux retardataires laissés sur le carreau ? Il reste un petit espoir. L’Apple Store en ligne suggère aux clients de revérifier les disponibilités pour un retrait en magasin à partir du 24 octobre. Attention toutefois : la firme de Cupertino n’a pas garanti que ses boutiques physiques disposeraient de stocks en libre-service.
Enfin, la solution viendra peut-être des distributeurs tiers. Des enseignes comme La Fnac, Boulanger ou Carrefour affichent encore la possibilité de précommander pour le 23 octobre. Une dernière fenêtre de tir qui risque, elle aussi, de se refermer très vite.

articles.title: ECOVACS DEEBOT X12S OmniCyclone robot vacuum mop review - sets a new cleaning standard - Tech Guide
articles.text:
VERDICT
The Ecovacs DEEBOT X12S OmniCyclone has established a new standard for robot vacuum mops. It's an investment in the cleanliness and hygiene of your home.
PROS
- Easy to set up and get started
- Excellent suction
- Next-level mopping
- Can be left alone for weeks
CONS
- Expensive for some
- Did leave dust behind after crossing threshold
- 
		
				
			VERDICT
Robot vacuum mops have come a long way with Ecovacs leading the way with its DEEBOT range and the X12S OmniCyclone has taken cleaning and convenience to another level.
Tech Guide has been testing the Ecovacs Robotics DEEBOT X12S OmniCyclone since shortly after it was unveiled at the IFA Show in Berlin in September.
Ecovacs has packed in plenty of features and upgrades into the X12S which has a new level of power that makes it an effective cleaner so you can get on with other things.
At our place we placed the X12S OmniCyclone station in the corner of our main living area.
This action alone speaks volumes about the look and design of the OmniCyclone station which has a sleek look with silver brushed metal accents.
Ecovacs has even thought to tint the clear dustbin to disguise the collected dust but still make it easy see how much dust is inside when you get closer.
The unit is 38cm wide and 49cm long which is a relatively small footprint for a device as powerful as this.
Set-up is simple through the Ecovacs app and the first step is connecting the robot to your wireless network and running any firmware upgrades.
What the robot needed to do next is map your home. It went off and scanned our floor plan on its own which is then shown in the app.
The AIVI 3D 4.0 technology did a great job creating the map but also is always on the lookout for any obstacles and steers around them.
The OmniCyclone Station is where the robot charges and includes a clean water tank and a tank where the dirty water will be transferred.
It’s also where the dust is transferred from the robot into the dustbin which can be easily emptied cleanly and conveniently into your garbage.
Now at our place, our floor is mainly tiles with a couple of carpeted rooms and a rug.
There is also a laundry and a small powder room, which have slightly higher thresholds the robot easily got up and over.
We did notice a couple of times the force of getting up and over the threshold left some dust behind.
Usually it picks this up on its way out but there was one occasion where we had to clean it ourselves.
The X12S OmniCyclone robot has a side brush, an anti-tangle main brush, along with an antibacterial filter and a roller that extends to reach in closer to skirting boards and under cabinets.
The OZMO ROLLER 3.0 has improved downward pressure (4000 Pa) and higher-speed (260 RPM) scrubbing which means stains don’t stand a chance.
And the roller lifts by 1.5cm and a smart roller cover clicks into place when it moves from hard floors to stay clear of carpets to them dry and avoid cross-contamination.
The unit also has 27,000 Pa blast suction which offers 53AW of suction power.
Now we know how powerful this suction is.
At IFA in Berlin we saw the X12S suck a 25kg ball up a tube so it had no issue vacuuming dust and debris off the hard floors and carpet at our place.
X12S also has FocusJet Stain technology which can pre-treat messes with extra water through the front jets shift more stubborn stains.
This needs to be enabled in the settings and includes a way to control exactly where in your home you would prefer a no-spray zone to protect furniture and other surfaces.
We left this on and it was remarkable how it could identify these areas and soak them ahead of a thorough clean with the roller.
We normally move chairs and clear the floor when we deploy the robot but the X12S OmniCyclone can find its way in and around your furniture quite deftly.
Through a combination of its side brushes and true edge extreme edge cleaning, the X12S did a tremendous job in getting into those hard-to-reach places as well as under and around furniture.
The X12S did a great job controlling water flow so there was never any residual water. It just left dry clean floors in its wake.
In terms of cleaning quality, the X12S has set a new standard.
The robots of the past were good at maintaining a level of cleanliness but the X12S really gets to work to get through the dirt and dust and stains effectively and leave you with a spotless home.
Our tiles were clean and shiny and it was easy to see just where the robot had traversed our carpets with the suction leaving definitive tracks just like a powerful stick vac would.
The robot would regularly return to the station to clean the roller and to transfer dirty water and replace it with clean water.
At the same time it was also recharging its battery to reduce interruptions and create more efficiency.
X12S can restore 13 per cent of the battery in just 3 minutes.
The DEEBOT X12S OmniCyclone is a complete cleaning solution that does a great job with your carpets and hard floors without you having to lift a finger.
It is really easy to maintain and can run on its own for weeks at a time.
The unit is priced at $2,999 which is an investment – it’s an investment in your time.
It means you get your time back instead of spending it vacuuming and mopping your floors.
VERDICT
The Ecovacs DEEBOT X12S OmniCyclone has established a new standard for robot vacuum mops. It’s an investment in the cleanliness and hygiene of your home.

articles.title: Voici les grandes étapes du Starship que le calendrier de la NASA fixe à SpaceX
articles.text:
À quoi faut-il s’attendre pour le programme spatial lunaire de la NASA et, plus particulièrement, pour tout ce qui est prévu du côté de SpaceX dans le cadre des missions Artémis ? L’agence spatiale américaine a fait un point à l’occasion du Congrès international d’astronautique (IAC), qui se tenait à Antalya, en Turquie, du 5 au 9 octobre 2026.
Un point d’autant plus nécessaire que les contours du programme Artémis ont évolué au cours des derniers mois. Steve Creech, qui dirige à la NASA le programme des atterrisseurs lunaires habités (HLS, pour Human Landing System), a présenté un calendrier actualisé pour le Starship, avec des jalons attendus trimestre par trimestre.
L’actuel planning découle du remaniement annoncé le 27 février 2026 par Jared Isaacman, administrateur de la NASA. Artémis III devait être le premier alunissage habité depuis Apollo 17, en 1972. Elle est devenue une mission d’essais en orbite autour de la Terre, avec quatre astronautes à bord, dont un Européen.
D’après la présentation, Artémis III doit décoller en 2027 (cela correspond aux plans présentés ce printemps) pour tester l’amarrage du vaisseau Orion avec les deux atterrisseurs en concurrence, celui de SpaceX et le Blue Moon de Blue Origin. Le premier alunissage passe à Artémis IV, début 2028, et le deuxième à Artémis V, fin 2028.
Les deux engins sont très différents. Le Starship lunaire est l’étage supérieur de la fusée lui-même : 52 mètres de haut, six moteurs Raptor au méthane, une cabine tout en haut et un ascenseur pour descendre les astronautes jusqu’au sol. Le Blue Moon, lui, mesure 16 mètres et ses passagers descendent par une échelle.
Ce calendrier laisse à Starship un peu plus d’un an pour réussir deux choses qu’il n’a jamais faites : faire le plein en orbite, puis se poser sur la Lune sans équipage, avant la fin de 2027. Le créneau est très serré, mais SpaceX a récemment progressé avec le Starship, notamment en matière de vol orbital.
Le plein en orbite début 2027, la Lune fin 2027
Voici les grandes étapes que le calendrier de la NASA fixe à SpaceX :
- fin 2026 : premier Starship rattrapé par la tour de lancement, premier vol depuis la Floride, première réutilisation d’un propulseur Super Heavy V3, et fin de la construction de « Cabin One », une cabine d’équipage grandeur nature testée au sol à Starbase, au Texas ;
- début 2027 : démonstration de transfert de carburant et deuxième pas de tir en Floride ;
- printemps 2027 : test des pieds d’atterrissage, essais du sas sur Cabin One et transport du vaisseau de test vers la Floride par barge ;
- été 2027 : mission Artémis III ;
- fin 2027 : premier vol d’un ravitailleur, lancement de l’atterrisseur de démonstration et alunissage sans équipage.
Pour la NASA, le transfert de carburant est l’un des plus gros défis techniques du programme.
Starship arrive en orbite les réservoirs quasi vides, car il a brûlé l’essentiel de son méthane et de son oxygène liquides pour quitter la Terre. Pour filer vers la Lune, il doit donc être rempli par d’autres Starship, qui servent de ravitailleurs. Ces liquides sont stockés sous les -160 °C, et personne n’a encore fait ce transfert d’un vaisseau à l’autre à cette échelle.
SpaceX n’a pas encore remporté la mise (le premier alunissage n’est pas attribué)
L’affaire n’est pas encore gagnée pour SpaceX. La NASA écrit noir sur blanc que l’atterrisseur d’Artémis IV n’est pas choisi à ce jour. Certes, SpaceX avait été retenu seul en 2021 pour ce premier alunissage. Depuis, il faut compter avec Blue Origin, qui prévoit son propre atterrissage sans équipage au cours du premier trimestre 2028. La concurrence est là.
SpaceX a d’ailleurs déjà pris du retard. Dans un rapport publié le 10 mars 2026, l’inspection générale de la NASA estime que le Starship lunaire a pris au moins deux ans de retard depuis la signature du contrat, en juillet 2021, et que d’autres décalages sont à prévoir. Les échéances posées par Elon Musk peinent ainsi à être respectées.
Au-delà de ce premier alunissage, la présentation esquisse la suite pour SpaceX, après 2028. Une version cargo de Starship, capable de déposer environ 15 tonnes sur la Lune, devrait y livrer un rover pressurisé développé par l’agence spatiale japonaise (JAXA). La NASA compte confier cette mission à SpaceX, mais pas avant son exercice budgétaire 2032, qui démarre en octobre 2031.
Jared Isaacman doit faire le point sur Artémis III et Artémis IV ce vendredi 23 octobre, à 20 heures (heure de Paris), lors d’une conférence de presse au centre spatial Kennedy, en Floride.

articles.title: The Next Wave: Are layoffs good for AI’s business?
articles.text: Cet article est aussi disponible en français First published on October 18, 2026 Microsoft ADC offices at Dunhill Towers in Nairobi, Kenya. Image: TechCabal Microsoft has shut its Africa Development Centre (ADC) in Nairobi, Kenya , leaving more than 400 engineers without jobs, following the closure of its Lagos engineering operation in May 2024. It has also closed sales offices in Windhoek, Abidjan, Dakar, Accra and Port-Louis. Microsoft says it “remains committed to Kenya”, but its retreat from the places where it once promised to build African engineering talent tells a different story. As the company and its peers pour billions into artificial intelligence (AI), these closures also reinforce a message that benefits the industry selling it. AI is coming for your job, and the companies building it are worth investing in. The Nairobi decision is difficult to explain through performance alone. Employees familiar with the centre say it had no quality or performance problems, and some received strong appraisal ratings before learning their jobs were at risk. Microsoft has not publicly said poor performance prompted the decision. People close to the matter say about five employees across customer and partner solutions, recruitment, and sales will remain in the affected operation. Announced in 2019, the centre was part of Microsoft’s $100 million commitment to build engineering capacity in Africa. The company planned to hire 500 engineers across Nairobi and Lagos, Nigeria, giving it access to local talent while offering African engineers the chance to work on products used worldwide. The Lagos hub closed in 2024 , and Nairobi is now following suit, exiting Microsoft’s engineering business on the continent. Microsoft may continue to serve African customers through its sales teams, cloud services, and other operations. But the closure of both engineering centres raises questions about the company’s long-term commitment to developing local technical talent. The people losing their jobs are not the only ones affected. Governments and universities that treated Microsoft’s investment as evidence of Africa’s place in the global technology industry must now reckon with its withdrawal. The cuts also feed a narrative that AI will soon become central to how businesses operate. AI companies have raised enormous sums on the promise that their technology will change work, and layoffs attributed to AI give investors another reason to believe that promise. Read smart insights about Francophone Africa’s tech ecosystem—weekly. Subscribe Layoffs are becoming part of the AI sales pitch Microsoft is not alone in using AI to explain workforce reductions. Amazon eliminated 14,000 corporate jobs in October 2025 and another 16,000 in January 2026, while Salesforce has linked its AI agents to a reduced need for customer support staff after cutting about 4,000 roles. In February 2026, Salesforce also laid off fewer than 1,000 employees across several functions. Across software, customer service, and other knowledge-based industries, AI has prompted companies to reconsider how many people they employ. Some of these changes are real, given that AI tools can write code, summarise documents, answer customer queries, and handle repetitive administrative tasks. Companies have good reason to test whether these tools can reduce their costs, and some jobs will disappear as businesses automate work. It would be wrong to dismiss every AI-related redundancy as a publicity exercise. The problem is that companies rarely separate the work AI can already perform from the work they expect it to perform in the future. A business might cut jobs because demand has weakened, teams overlap, or management wants to improve margins. AI may contribute to the decision, but it can also provide a convenient explanation for restructuring that would have happened anyway. Cutting staff can improve a company’s financial results immediately, while the productivity gains promised by AI may take years to materialise. A company can reduce its payroll and report better margins before proving that its AI investments will generate enough money to cover its costs. The promise of future productivity can therefore help justify decisions whose immediate financial benefits come from employing fewer people. There is also a commercial benefit to making AI appear unavoidable. When Microsoft, Amazon, or Salesforce announces cuts linked to AI, other executives face pressure to show they are preparing for the same future. Businesses fear falling behind, workers worry about their jobs, and investors look for companies positioned to profit. The announcements help sell AI as a necessity rather than a technology whose value must be judged against its cost. There is no evidence that companies are coordinating layoffs to drive up demand for AI stocks. But the language surrounding the cuts can still benefit an industry whose valuations depend on investors believing that AI will become indispensable. That is worth examining, especially as two of its biggest players prepare to approach public markets. Moonshot 2026 is almost here! Get 30% off all tickets during our FLASH SALE from October 16–24 and join us in Lagos on October 28–29. Get your tickets now! The IPO is where the story gets expensive OpenAI announced a funding round involving $122 billion in committed capital in March 2026, valuing the company at $852 billion after the investment. Microsoft has committed $13 billion to OpenAI through their partnership since 2019, of which $11.9 billion had been funded by June 2026, according to Microsoft’s annual filing . These figures cover different parts of OpenAI’s financing and should not be treated as separate investments. Anthropic has attracted similarly large sums, raising $65 billion in May 2026 at a post-money valuation of $965 billion. That same month, the company reported an annualised revenue run rate above $47 billion. A public listing would give the companies access to a broader pool of investors and allow some existing shareholders to sell their stakes. Investors who backed them privately could realise substantial returns if the market values them at levels above their previous funding rounds. The story they sell to public investors will need to justify those valuations. OpenAI has reported rapid revenue growth, but it has yet to establish sustained profitability. Its spending on computing infrastructure and model development remains high, and projections suggest it may not generate positive cash flow until 2030. Revenue growth alone does not indicate whether the company can earn enough to cover the costs of developing and operating its systems. Anthropic reported $16.8 billion in third-quarter revenue in October 2026 and adjusted profitability for a second consecutive quarter, although its growth has slowed from earlier in the year. Adjusted profitability does not tell investors everything about the company’s long-term costs or whether it can sustain its margins. Both OpenAI and Anthropic have found strong demand for their products, and AI already has practical uses in software development, research, and customer support. They still need to prove they can turn that demand into profits and justify what investors are paying for them. The blockchain boom of the 2010s offers a useful comparison, as investors were told the technology would change finance, agriculture, and supply chains, yet many promised applications never reached mainstream use. Blockchain had practical uses, but that did not make every company built around it a sound investment. AI could have a far greater commercial impact, but its potential does not guarantee that every company selling it will succeed. Microsoft’s African closures do not prove a plan to inflate AI valuations, but they show how the company can abandon a long-term investment in local engineering while the industry it belongs to asks investors to believe AI will define the future of business. More than 400 engineers are losing their jobs, while investors are being offered a chance to profit from the technology being presented as the future of work. The market should judge AI companies by the money they make, not just the money they raise or the jobs their customers cut. By the time OpenAI and Anthropic reach public markets, investors will have heard plenty about AI’s ability to replace workers. They will need to ask a harder question about whether the businesses promising that future can make enough money to justify their valuations. articles.title: Le secret de Google Maps pour prédire les embouteillages avant même que vous n'y arriviez
articles.text:
Comment l'intelligence artificielle de Google Maps anticipe l'évolution des embouteillages
En utilisant Google Maps tous les jours, vous vous êtes sûrement déjà demandé comment l’application devinait les bouchons avant même votre départ ? Voici son secret.
Vous prenez le volant pour aller travailler et Google Maps affiche soudainement une ligne rouge vif sur votre itinéraire habituel. L’app vous annonce des bouchons un peu plus loin et vous propose immédiatement un chemin alternatif pour gagner de précieuses minutes. Cette capacité à prédire les embouteillages avec une précision chirurgicale semble presque magique, et pourtant, elle repose simplement sur un appareil que tous les conducteurs ont déjà en poche : le smartphone.
Crowdsourcing : la méthode secrète de Google Maps pour prédire le trafic
L’astuce principale de Maps repose sur un système extrêmement simple et pourtant massif, nommé crowdsourcing. Grâce à lui, Google n’a absolument pas besoin de caméras sur les routes pour savoir que la circulation est à l’arrêt, seulement de la mise en commun des positions de milliers de smartphones.
Lorsque vous roulez avec l’application ouverte, voire simplement en arrière-plan, votre téléphone envoie constamment des données GPS anonymisées aux serveurs de Google. Il indique votre position exacte et la vitesse à laquelle vous vous déplacez. En croisant ces informations avec celles des autres conducteurs présents sur le même axe routier, l’algorithme dresse une carte instantanée du trafic.
Si la vitesse moyenne d’un groupe de véhicules chute brutalement sur une portion d’autoroute, Google Maps en déduit immédiatement qu’un ralentissement ou un bouchon est en train de se former. La ligne bleue de votre trajet vire alors à l’orange, puis au rouge, pour vous alerter en amont.
Calcul d'itinéraire : comment l’algorithme trouve le chemin le plus rapide
Détecter un ralentissement est une chose, mais trouver la déviation idéale en une fraction de seconde en est une autre. Pour accomplir cette prouesse, Google s’appuie sur ses propres algorithmes et des années de données historiques. L’app ne se contente donc pas d’observer la situation actuelle, elle analyse les schémas de circulation passés pour anticiper l’évolution du bouchon dans les minutes à venir.
Pour vous proposer un nouvel itinéraire, l’algorithme va alors diviser la zone géographique en une multitude de petits segments. Il calcule le temps de parcours de chaque alternative en prenant en compte les limitations de vitesse, la typologie des routes et les éventuels feux de circulation. Si le temps passé sur le meilleur trajet secondaire devient inférieur au temps perdu dans l’itinéraire principal, Google Maps vous suggère automatiquement de changer de route.
Vous participez ainsi, sans le savoir, à une immense carte collaborative gérée par l'intelligence artificielle.

articles.title: Bras robot et écran géant : Apple préparerait un nouveau HomeView qui vous suit du regard
articles.text:
Apple vient à peine de lancer son HomeView qu’une version plus ambitieuse fait déjà parler d’elle. D’après les informations du journaliste Mark Gurman, la marque travaillerait d’ores et déjà sur un modèle plus haut de gamme, capable de corriger l’un des principaux défauts de la proposition.
 Power On: Apple’s new HomeView shows the undeniable potential of a higher-end version with a robotic arm. https://t.co/NVMPS3cJOo
— Mark Gurman (@markgurman) October 18, 2026
Un écran qui se tourne tout seul
Comme le rappelle l’informateur, Apple propose actuellement deux versions du HomeView. L’un des écrans est pensé comme un cadre à poser au mur, tandis que l’autre peut se poser sur une table ou sur le plan de travail d’une cuisine. Quand plusieurs personnes entourent l’appareil, il faut le réorienter à la main. Chaque utilisateur doit tourner l’écran vers lui pour pouvoir s’en servir correctement. Apple voudrait corriger ce problème avec le futur HomeView.
D’après le journaliste Bloomberg, la future version serait équipée d’un bras motorisé capable de faire pivoter l’écran à 360 degrés en cas de besoin. Grâce à la reconnaissance vocale, déjà implémentée sur la version actuelle, l’appareil identifierait qui parle et se tournerait automatiquement vers son interlocuteur du moment. Le fonctionnement du bras rappelle évidemment Center Stage, la fonction qui recadre l’image sur vous pendant un appel vidéo, mais en version motorisée.
Ce n’est pas tout. Apple miserait aussi sur un écran plus spacieux. Le groupe miserait cette fois sur un écran de 9 pouces, contre 7 pouces pour le HomeView actuel. Selon Mark Gurman, Apple pourrait choisir de baptiser ce futur appareil « HomeView Max », « Ultra » ou « 360 ». Il ne remplacerait pas le modèle actuel, mais viendrait l’accompagner, enrichissant ainsi la gamme d’appareils Apple taillés pour la maison connectée. Selon Bloomberg, le HomeView robotisé pourrait arriver sur le marché dès l’année prochaine, voire en 2028. Gageons que ce modèle haut de gamme puisse faire son entrée sur le marché européen.
À lire aussi : Les rescapés de l’Apple Car réinventent la voiture… en s’inspirant du buggy lunaire d’Apollo
Un vieux projet de robot maison
L’idée d’un bras robotisé n’est pas nouvelle chez Apple. Après l’abandon du projet Apple Car, le géant de Cupertino avait réorienté ses ambitions robotiques de l’automobile vers la maison autour de 2024. Un appareil estimé autour de 1 000 dollars avait alors été évoqué par une série de fuites. Quelques mois plus tard, Apple avait même dévoilé le concept d’une lampe robotisée qui exprime des émotions et peut bouger. Ce concept était très proche de la fameuse mascotte des studios Pixar. Il ne s’agissait encore que d’un projet de recherche, mais il montrait bien dans quelle direction Apple ambitionnait d’aller.

articles.title: La Unión Astronómica Internacional ha medido la contaminación lumínica de los satélites y ha descubierto que tenemos un problema
articles.text:
Se habla mucho de la contaminación lumínica que ejercen los sistemas de iluminación urbana. Una farola mal posicionada o con una luz excesivamente azul puede ser dañina para las plantas, los animales e incluso los humanos. También complica el trabajo de los astrónomos, ya que no suele tratarse de una sola farola, sino de un conjunto que genera una especie de hongo iluminado sobre las ciudades. El cielo pierde su oscuridad natural y cuesta ver los objetos más tenues del cielo. Pero precisamente en este ámbito hay una contaminación lumínica aún peor que la de las ciudades: la de los satélites en la órbita terrestre baja (LEO).
Contándolos. Como esto es algo que se sabe bien, la Unión Astronómica Internacional (UAI) declaró que estos satélites deberían tener un límite de magnitud visible de alrededor de 7 o más, lo cual significa que son invisibles a simple vista. Desgraciadamente, hay muchos que no lo cumplen. Hasta ahora, sabíamos que eran demasiados, pero no teníamos cifras exactas, por lo que un equipo de científicos de la Universidad Western Ontario ha decidido hacer los cálculos. Las cifras son bastantes preocupantes y sacan los colores a dos constelaciones en concreto: Starlink y Guowang.
Las cifras. Estos científicos utilizaron seis cámaras para observar el cielo desde el Observatorio Elginfield en Ontario. Tomaron medidas durante 36 noches, entre el 7 de octubre y el 11 de noviembre de 2024 y en total analizaron 24.812 rastros de 5.118 satélites únicos en LEO. Durante el crepúsculo, la hora más conflictiva, se estudiaron 15.591 pasos de satélites, de los cuales 14.997 eran más brillantes que el límite de la UAI. Eso supone un 96%.
El mejor de la clase. La constelación mejor puntuada en este estudio fue OneWeb, ya que solo el 6% de sus pasos estuvieron por encima del límite. Además, su magnitud mediana es de 7,3.
Los peores. En términos absolutos, la constelación que más contribuye a esta contaminación lumínica es Starlink, ya que dos tercios de todos los pasos de satélites que superaban los límites pertenecían a ella. No obstante, cabe destacar que esta es la constelación que más satélites tiene en el cielo. Actualmente hay algo más de 10.000, aunque en el momento del estudio eran 6.000. Si contamos solo el número de satélites, es fácil que sea la que tiene una cantidad mayor de infractores. Sin embargo, si nos centramos en los porcentajes, hay otra constelación con peor nota: Guowang.
La constelación china tiene un 50% de pasos de satélites por encima del límite de la UAI, mientras que la de SpaceX solo supera esta cifra con un 25% de ellos.
Todo irá a peor. En el momento del estudio, la constelación Guowang tenía solo 12 satélites en órbita. Hoy en día tiene 300 y planea lanzar más. En cuanto a SpaceX, planea poner un millón de satélites en el cielo para abastecer sus centros de datos. No serían de Starlink, sino que estarían conectados a ellos; pero, dadas sus cifras actuales, es esperable que una parte de ellos exceda los límites. Por eso, se debería endurecer la legislación al respecto cuanto antes.
Las consecuencias. Muchos observatorios astronómicos ya están experimentando las consecuencias de la contaminación lumínica procedente de satélites y todo puede empeorar. Por ejemplo, en un estudio reciente se calculó que, si se sigue esta cadencia, en el Observatorio Vera Rubin, en Chile, una de cada tres exposiciones al crepúsculo podría verse contaminada.
De momento las consecuencias son solo para la astronomía. Los efectos sobre la salud animal y vegetal se deben a la contaminación lumínica urbana. Sin embargo, la luz procedente de un millón de satélites sí podría empezar a tener efectos aquí en la superficie terrestre.
Las soluciones se quedan cortas. Algunas compañías, como SpaceX, están empezando a pintar sus satélites de negro para reducir su brillo. Claramente, funcionan. La luz que reflejan los satélites se reduce notablemente. Sin embargo, de momento se han hecho pocas mediciones y el porcentaje de eficacia varía mucho de unas fuentes a otras. En lo que parece coincidir la mayoría es en que, aunque se reduzca el brillo, en muchos casos puede seguir por encima de los límites. Por eso, se debe legislar más y buscar nuevas soluciones antes de que la cantidad de satélites en el cielo genere una contaminación inabarcable.
